title: Think you can stop at exactly 99%? Sounds easy, right?
author: Haolge996
selftext:
I made a tiny game with one simple goal:  
  
Fill the glass to exactly 99%.  
  
Sounds easy. Until you try it. 😅  
  
How close can you get?

Play it here: [https://www.astrocade.com/games/99-full/01M570H3QMMKN6R6MDVDEW9M9C?sharedByCreator=haolge996&surface=web&sharePlatform=copylink&shareId=e1e52e26-0e31-4315-bc2e-70d4afd8a897&shareOrigin=profile](https://www.astrocade.com/games/99-full/01M570H3QMMKN6R6MDVDEW9M9C?sharedByCreator=haolge996&surface=web&sharePlatform=copylink&shareId=e1e52e26-0e31-4315-bc2e-70d4afd8a897&shareOrigin=profile)

comments.author: ParkInsider
comments.body:
Funny enough I went with the same idea for my first extremely simple game. Looks great!

How did you make it look so good?

replies.author: Haolge996
replies.body: Haha, great minds think alike! 😄 Thanks! I actually built the whole thing with Codex, including the visuals.

comments.author: thetinytrex
comments.body: This 100% comes off as one of those scammy facebook/Instagram ads. Even your title reads like one. You know what, this is probably an ad. God damn internet.

replies.author: Haolge996
replies.body:
Lol, now that you mention it, the title really does sound like one of those ads 💀

I just made a tiny game with Codex and wanted to share it. But yeah, I can see why it came across that way.
